units.source_text: 到了九月里，处处红叶呈艳，秋好皇后院内秋景之美，不可言喻。

en.t: By the ninth month, brilliant red leaves appeared everywhere, and the beauty of the autumn scenery within Empress Akikonomu's residence was beyond words.

units.source_text: 有一天秋风瑟瑟的夕暮，皇后用砚盒盖盛了各种红叶，派一个女童致送给紫姬。

en.t: One evening, as the autumn wind rustled bleakly, the Empress arranged many kinds of red leaves on the lid of an inkstone box and sent a young girl to deliver them to Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 这女童年龄较长，身穿浓紫色衫子，上罩淡紫面蓝里的外衣，

en.t: This girl was somewhat older; she wore a deep purple robe, with an outer garment over it that was pale purple on the outside and blue on the lining,

units.source_text: 外披红黄色罗汗袗，模样异常姣好。

en.t: and over that she had draped a reddish-yellow gauze robe, making her look exceptionally lovely.

units.source_text: 她穿过回廊，走过拱桥，来到紫姬院内。

en.t: She passed through the covered corridor, crossed the arched bridge, and came into Lady Murasaki's residence.

units.source_text: 这是一种风雅的仪式，普通都派年长的侍女致送。

en.t: This was a refined ceremony, and ordinarily an older lady-in-waiting would be sent to make the delivery.

units.source_text: 但秋好皇后为了这女童十分可爱，因此特地派她。

en.t: But because Empress Akikonomu found this girl so charming, she deliberately sent her instead.

units.source_text: 这女童惯于伺候贵人，举止大方，仪态优雅，为他人所不可及。

en.t: The girl was accustomed to serving noble people; her bearing was poised and her manners graceful, beyond what others could match.
